international.title: Badenoch says using amputee athletes to justify cutting disability benefits was ‘message of hope’ – UK politics live
international.summary: PM has asked Badenoch to withdraw her suggestion that benefits should be cut because ‘double amputees run marathons’ During his interview round this morning, Matthew Pennycook said the Ministry of Justice is in “dialogue” with Google as it tries to get the tech firm to take down the Russell Brand video. (See 10.04pm .) A spokesperson for the Ministry of Justice said: It is only right that the government asks for content that is distressing for victims to be taken down and we strongly believe YouTube should remove this content. Removal ultimately depends on the platform’s own terms. We’re aware of the new content and our teams are investigating. We suspended Russell Brand’s channel from the YouTube Partner Programme in September 2023. The channel has not been able to monetise on YouTube since then. Continue reading...
